policies.name: Loi AGEC — Anti-Waste and Circular Economy Law
policies.summary: Targets the end of single-use plastic packaging by 2040; bans many single-use items; obliges restaurants to use reusable tableware for dine-in.

sources.publisher: Ministère de la Transition écologique, France

newsFeed.headline: France's reusable tableware rule for fast-food restaurants reaches first anniversary
newsFeed.summary: One year in, the rule requiring fast-food chains in France to serve dine-in meals on reusable plates has cut single-use plastic by an estimated 180,000 tonnes.

wooby.headline: France makes fast-food restaurants use real plates if you eat in.
wooby.narrative: Wooby thinks this is a great idea: in France, if you eat your burger inside the restaurant, it has to come on a real plate, not a plastic one. Wooby has heard it has saved a LOT of plastic.

sources.publisher: Ministère de la Transition écologique, France
